title: radio.py: LatencyRule stash re-injects after chaos drop/jam/partition
description:
## Problem

`_get_rx_result_internal` in `python/src/lichen/sim/simulation/radio.py` applies `ChaosEngine.apply_all` only to **live** medium candidates (~L409-421). After that loop, stashed LatencyRule candidates are appended when their txid is absent from `present_ids` (~L423-427), **without** running `apply_all` again.

Two concrete bypasses:

1. **Post-TxEnd drop/jam/partition is ignored.** After `TxEndEvent`, `Medium.get_rx_candidates` is empty, so the only path is stash re-injection. A `DropRule` / `LossRule` / `JammerRule` / `PartitionRule` / `GilbertElliottRule` that would drop the live candidate never sees it. LatencyRule + any other chaos rule is not compositional after airtime.

2. **Live apply_all returning None re-animates the stash.** If the TX is still in-flight and `apply_all` drops the candidate (`result is None`), it is not added to `filtered_candidates`, so `txid not in present_ids`. The copy stashed at TX start (`_stash_delayed_rx_candidates` ~L375-381, or an earlier poll ~L419-420) is then appended and can still pass the latency filter. A drop at poll time is undone by the stash.

Probabilistic rules (LossRule, Gilbert-Elliott) are evaluated at TX-start stash time and then frozen; later independent draws never apply to the delayed path.

## Why this is robustness

The stash exists so LatencyRule can delay past `TxEndEvent`. Holding a chaos-applied snapshot is reasonable, but re-injecting it after a later drop, or instead of a drop, means fault injection lies once delay is involved. `test_latency_bounded_with_added_delay` uses LatencyRule alone, so this is untested.

## Files

- `python/src/lichen/sim/simulation/radio.py` (`_stash_delayed_rx_candidates`, `_get_rx_result_internal` present_ids re-inject)
- `python/tests/sim/test_multihop_latency_bounds.py` (only LatencyRule, no composed drop)
design: Re-injected stash candidates must go through apply_all (or be dropped if a later live apply_all returned None for that txid). If apply_all returns None, pop the stash entry. Do not freeze a TX-start snapshot past a subsequent Drop/Loss/Jammer/Partition match. Add a test: LatencyRule + DropRule on the same hop; packet must not be delivered after end+added.
acceptance_criteria: A candidate dropped by apply_all at poll time is not re-delivered from _delayed_rx. After TxEnd, DropRule/JammerRule/PartitionRule still apply to the delayed path. A composed LatencyRule+DropRule test expects no RX after eligibility.
close_reason: Stash holds the pre-chaos original candidate and re-runs ChaosEngine.apply_all on re-inject. Drop/jam/partition added after TxEnd now drop the delayed frame instead of bypassing later rules.
